tmean_c.description: Weekly mean of daily mean temperature (T2M).

tmax_c.description: Weekly maximum of daily maximum temperature (T2M_MAX).

tmin_c.description: Weekly minimum of daily minimum temperature (T2M_MIN).

soil_moisture_anomaly.description: Root-zone wetness minus the baseline weekly normal, in baseline standard deviations. Not adjusted by scenarios.

et0_mm.description: Weekly reference evapotranspiration, Hargreaves-Samani from temperature.

frost_prob.description: Mean = share of years whose weekly minimum is at or below frost_c.

heat_prob.description: Mean = share of years whose weekly maximum is at or above heat_c.

extreme_rain_prob.description: Mean = share of years with at least one day at or above extreme_rain_mm.

dry_spell_prob.description: Mean = share of years in which the week is inside a dry spell (dry_spell_days in a row below dry_day_mm).

sources_used.name: NASA POWER
sources_used.resolution_note: Regional estimate on a 0.5 x 0.625 degree grid (about 50 km), not a field sensor.

quality.resolution_note: Weekly values per site point; daily series aggregated to 52 weeks. No spatial blending.

sources.name: NASA POWER daily point (MERRA-2 meteorology)
sources.license: No restrictions on use; citation requested by the NASA POWER Project
sources.attribution: Data from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program.

caveats: Weather is a regional estimate from NASA POWER, not measured on this field.
Rain is not bias-corrected against local gauges.
Reference evapotranspiration is estimated from temperature only (Hargreaves-Samani), so it is modeled.
Probabilities are shares of past years, not forecasts.
Thresholds marked assumed are stated choices; see `thresholds`.
Limited data: no seeded soil or satellite data for this location; weather-derived features only.
